Jose’s knowledge changes between Scenario 1 and Scenario 2.

In Scenario 1, Jose knows only that Patricia seems withdrawn and that she says it is “personal stuff.” He does not know the specific cause. His emotion is general concern and willingness to listen.

In Scenario 2, Jose overhears Patricia on the phone worrying about bills and financial commitments. He then also hears her confirm that she has been overwhelmed with bills. This gives him a more specific reason for her distress. His concern therefore deepens, even though he still does not know all the details of her finances or personal situation.

The shift in emotion is best explained by Jose’s increased concern after learning about Patricia’s apparent financial troubles.
